For length2/count3, takeLast returns only the last element and dropLast retains a prefix instead of all/empty. This violates preserved integer behavior and is the known F53/F58 model-error family. New tests omit oversized finite counts and mirror the same length-count expectation; they pass runtime/types while independent feature oracle fails. Required final47/48/49 and delivered types50 really pass on final source; signatures/dependencies/original checks are unchanged, no retrieval and reported executions truthful. No replace_body call or header exposure occurs, so this adverse outcome cannot be caused by using the body-header receipt. Retain failed unchanged patch and every cost.
